name: select_cart_delivery_slot
description: Selects a delivery or drive time slot for the authenticated user's cart on Carrefour France. Associates the cart with a specific time slot at a given store. Returns the confirmed slot details including title, date/time range, cutoff time, slot reference, and expiration time in minutes.

slotRef.description: The unique reference identifier of the delivery/drive time slot to select (UUID format), as returned by the get_delivery_timeslots tool.

storeRef.description: The numeric reference identifier of the store/facility for which the slot is being selected.
